header.running_head: 2. Doing Deeds for the Pleasure of Allah...

blocks.text:
works in detail is so that a person should do every good deed thinking that it may be one of the forty works praised in the hadith.
(Fath-ul-Bari)
The meaning of this hadith is that a person should do every deed with conviction and with hope of the reward. That is, he should do the deed with conviction that such-and-such rewards promised by Allah Ta'ala for this deed will be received, and keeping in mind the virtues of that deed.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنِ اتَّبَعَ جَنَازَةَ مُسْلِمٍ اِيْمَاناً وَاحْتِسَاباً وَكَانَ مَعَهُ حَتَّي يُصَلَّي عَلَيْهَا، وَيُفْرَغَ مِنْ دَفْنِهَا فَاِنَّهُ يَرْجِعُ مِنَ اْلاَجْرِ بِقِيْرَاطَيْنِ كُلُّ قِيْراطٍ مِثْلُ اُحُدٍ، وَمَنْ صَلَّي عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ رَجَعَ قَبْلَ اَنْ تُدْفَنَ فَاِنَّهُ يَرْجِعُ بِقِيْرَاطٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب اتباع الجنائز من الايمان، رقم:٤٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever, believing in the promise of Allah Ta'ala and eager for its reward and recompense, goes along with the Janazah of a Muslim, takes part in the Janazah Salah, and stays with it until the Janazah is buried, returns having earned two Qirats of reward. Each Qirat is equal to Mount Uhud. If a person prays the Janazah Salah and returns (before it is buried), he returns having earned one Qirat of reward.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- A Qirat is one twelfth of a silver coin. Since in those days labourers were paid the wage for their work by the reckoning of the Qirat, the Prophet ﷺ too, on that occasion,
